w10_T4_001285: A minibus company counts its takings in whole dollars rather than in cents. Each of the 9 drivers brought in 218 dollars on Monday, and all of it went into one account. A passenger then paid 77 dollars for a group booking. Fuel for the week cost the company 1686 dollars. Over the following month the account grew to 5 times what it held, and repairs then took 1533 dollars out of it. The owners shared what was left equally between the 2 partners. How many dollars did one partner receive?
w10_T4_001287: A stationery factory keeps all of its sticker sheets in one warehouse. The first machine printed 137 sheets and the second machine doubled that number. Every one of those sheets was then reprinted for each of the 8 designs in the range. The factory has 3 loading doors. The whole print run was repeated for each of the 7 countries the company sells to, and then again for each of the 8 languages the stickers are printed in. How many sticker sheets are in the warehouse?
w10_T4_001295: A cattle farm records its feed in whole sacks rather than in kilograms, and its barn is 30 metres long. The barn held 236 sacks in the autumn, a mill delivered 7 more, and a neighbour brought 24. The farmer then bought enough for the barn to hold 4 times as many sacks as it did. He repeated that build-up 5 times over so the barn would last several winters. A dozen calves were born that month, a supplier gave 57 sacks as a gift, and the cattle ate 1139 sacks over the winter. How many sacks of feed are left in the barn?
w10_T4_001301: A photo album has 16 pages, and each page holds 4 photographs. One family filled 9 albums of that size with holiday pictures. The photographs were then shared equally between the 3 children in the family. One of them gave 164 of her photographs to her grandmother. Half of her pictures had been taken at the seaside. How many photographs does that child have left?
w10_T4_001305: A decorator started a job with 45 tins of paint and bought 61 more. A supplier then sent 48 tins and a customer returned 41 unopened tins. All the tins were shared equally between the 3 crews on the site, and one crew carried its share up to the top floor. The building has 12 floors. That crew used 60 tins on the walls. The firm now needs 5 crews supplied with as many tins as that crew has left. How many tins will the firm need?
w10_T4_001307: A running club keeps all of its race T-shirts in one cupboard. The cupboard held 125 shirts in March, and a sponsor sent 26 more. A shop donated another 62 shirts to the same cupboard. The club then ordered enough shirts for the cupboard to hold 8 times as many as it did. Half of the shirts are printed in blue. A member finally returned 60 shirts that had not been handed out. How many shirts are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_001309: A theatre keeps all of its spare seat cushions in one store. On Friday morning the store held 226 cushions, and 29 more arrived from the upholsterer. In the afternoon 155 cushions were taken out for the matinee and never brought back. The theatre was built in 1890. That evening the manager ordered enough cushions for the store to hold 4 times as many as were left. The company now wants 7 theatres stocked in exactly the same way. How many cushions will the 7 theatres hold?
w10_T4_001311: Anders cuts more timber in a day than his partner Britt does. The yard held 98 planks, and a delivery brought 74 more. The sawmill then supplied 8 times that many planks for a big order. Britt added 54 planks she had been storing at home. A barn conversion used 760 planks and a school project took another 550. How many planks are left in the yard?
w10_T4_001313: Mika's fish farm holds more salmon than Tomas's farm does. One pen held 196 young salmon until 77 of them were released into a river. The farm then stocked 9 pens with exactly that many fish in each. The farm's jetty is 25 metres long. Over the season 691 salmon were sold to a smokehouse and 333 went to the market. How many salmon are left on the farm?
w10_T4_001314: On Monday morning a school kitchen had 200 lunch trays in the rack. A delivery added 48 trays before break, and 8 were dropped and broken. At lunchtime another 48 trays came back from the dining hall. During the afternoon 133 trays were taken to the sports hall for a match. That evening the county ordered enough trays for the school to hold 6 times as many, and the trays were then shared equally between the 3 buildings on the site. Half of the trays are green. How many trays went to one building?
w10_T4_001326: A bike shop records its repair jobs in hours rather than in minutes, and Ravi mends more punctures than his apprentice Lotte does. On Monday morning the shop had 40 inner tubes, and 25 of them were fitted to customers' bikes. In the afternoon a wholesaler delivered 8 times as many tubes as were left in the shop. That evening half of the tubes were sent to the shop's second branch. Overnight 4 tubes were found to be perished and were thrown away. How many inner tubes does the shop have now?
w10_T4_001327: Priya's card company prints more than her rival Stefan's company does. Her store room was filled with 9 pallets, each holding 234 greeting cards. A second print run doubled the number of cards in the room. Over the year 1947 cards were sold from that room, and a shop returned 41 unsold cards to it. The company then opened 8 store rooms stocked to exactly that level, and repeated the whole plan in each of the 7 regions where it trades. How many greeting cards does the company hold in total?
w10_T4_001328: A sailing club records its trips in hours rather than in minutes. On Saturday morning the club had 202 life jackets in the shed, and a grant paid for 70 more. At midday a neighbouring club merged with it and doubled the number of jackets in the shed. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 29 more. That evening 355 jackets were taken to the regatta and never came back. How many life jackets are in the shed now?
w10_T4_001330: A school keeps all of its raffle tickets in one box. The box held 44 books of tickets, and half of them were sent over to the infant school. Every book still in the box was then replaced by 6 books printed for the summer fair. The fair is always held on the 3rd of July. Half of the books in the box were sold in the first week and taken away. A parent then added 29 books that had not been used last year. How many books of tickets are in the box now?
w10_T4_001333: A hospital car park is counted in whole spaces rather than in square metres, and Dr Oyelaran uses it more often than Dr Kim does. The park had 46 free spaces in the morning, and 74 more became free when a clinic finished. During the day 35 cars arrived and then another 40. In the evening 69 cars left the car park. The trust now plans 8 car parks with as many free spaces as this one has. How many free spaces will the 8 car parks have?
w10_T4_001336: An office keeps all of its phone chargers in one drawer, and it logs its repair jobs in hours rather than in minutes. The drawer held 43 chargers, and 2 of them had frayed cables and were binned. A visiting team took 4 chargers away, and a training course used up another 29. Half of the staff work from home on Fridays. The company now wants 9 drawers, each holding as many chargers as this one. How many chargers will the 9 drawers hold?
w10_T4_001350: On Monday morning a coffee roastery had 137 bags of beans in the store, and a farm delivered 25 more. In the afternoon the roastery ordered enough beans for the store to hold 6 times as many bags as it did. The roastery has 4 delivery vans. That evening a cafe returned 37 bags it had not been able to sell. On Tuesday a supplier added 18 bags, and on Wednesday another 47 arrived. How many bags of beans are in the store now?
w10_T4_001357: On Saturday morning a tennis club found 22 balls in the ball basket, and half of them were too worn to use and were thrown away. Before lunch a member donated 66 new balls to the basket. In the afternoon the coach added 12 balls he had in his car. That evening a supplier delivered 41 more. How many balls are in the basket now?
w10_T4_001358: An exam office keeps all of its spare answer booklets in one cupboard. The cupboard held 185 booklets, and 21 of them were used for a mock test. The printer then delivered 68 more booklets to the cupboard. Before the summer exams the office tripled the number of booklets in the cupboard. During the exams 425 booklets were handed out. How many booklets are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_001362: On Sunday morning a cafe cooked 72 pancakes and shared them equally between the 6 tables that were waiting, and Alma's table always eats more than Boris's table does. Before lunch Alma's table ate 4 of its pancakes. The cafe has 20 chairs. In the afternoon the cook made 4 times as many pancakes as were still on Alma's table and brought them over. That evening a neighbour dropped off 5 more pancakes for the same table. How many pancakes does Alma's table have now?
w10_T4_001364: A railway depot keeps all of its spare sleepers in one siding. A delivery of 3 wagons brought 163 sleepers in each wagon to that siding. A track repair then used 358 of them. An inspector returned 19 sleepers that were still sound. Half of the sleepers in the siding were sent on to another depot. A footpath project took 35 more sleepers away. How many sleepers are left in the siding?
w10_T4_001372: On Monday morning a bakery filled 5 trays with 61 pies on each tray and put them all in one warmer, and Ola bakes more pies than Timo does. Timo added 24 pies he had made the night before. Before lunch 220 pies were sold to a factory canteen. In the afternoon a school took 39 pies, and that evening a hotel collected 41 more. How many pies are left in the warmer?
w10_T4_001373: A builders' merchant counts its stock in single sacks rather than in pallets. The yard took in 6 lorries, each carrying 192 sacks of cement. A customer then returned 38 sacks that had never been opened. The merchant built the yard up to 7 times that number of sacks for the building season. Over the summer 2272 sacks were sold. How many sacks of cement are in the yard now?
w10_T4_001374: A museum records its tours in hours rather than in minutes. On Friday morning the desk had 83 audio guides, and 50 were handed out to a coach party. Before lunch a school group took 8 more, and in the afternoon 14 went to other visitors. The museum has 9 galleries. That evening the director ordered enough guides for the desk to hold 4 times as many as were left. On Saturday 6 guides were sent away for repair. How many audio guides does the desk have now?
w10_T4_001376: A crayon factory counts its output in single crayons rather than in boxes. Each tray holds 158 crayons, and every carton holds 4 trays. A pallet takes 6 cartons, and an inspector added 17 loose crayons to one pallet. The lorry is then loaded with 6 pallets of that size. Half of the crayons are made in bright colours. Schools ordered 19449 crayons from that lorry and a warehouse took another 504. How many crayons are left on the lorry?
